verdict.detail: The album's main issue on Discogs isn't vinyl; this is from the first year it was pressed on vinyl, one of 2 that year.

notes.text:
Konono Nº1 features three electric likembés (thumb pianos), megaphones, hand-made microphones and percussion built from old car parts.
Recorded in Halle de la Gombe, Kinshasa, Congo, except track 5 recorded live at the Paradiso in Amsterdam.
Mixed in Hotel Matonge, Kinshasa, Congo and Studio XXL, Brussels.
Published by Les Editions de la Bascule / Strictly Confidential.
Licensed from Crammed Discs.

On green vinyl with insert detailing credits.
